lessons_used: 'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests.
'sign_in, redesign' changes have consistently shown negative results after noise correction across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for 'adoption, redesign', 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as tests either lack a second trial or disagree on effect.
Predictions have mostly been overestimated compared to noise-corrected measurements, though rounds 7, 8, 9, 12, 13, and 14 were underestimated.

candidates.title: pick_friend_trait_filter_hint
candidates.change: Show a clear hint on the pick_friend screen assuring users that pet traits and appearance can be changed at any time after setup.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (68.4%) and high median completion time (89s), indicating user hesitation during pet selection.

pick_friend.hint: Don't worry, you can customize your pet's appearance and personality anytime later.

guard.reason: Adding an explanatory customization hint on the pick_friend screen is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption stage loses the most users (68.4% conversion); adding a clear hint is low-risk and config-only.

candidates.title: new_pet_visibility_helper_screen
candidates.change: Add a new screen after home intro guiding users on how to locate the pet icon in the system tray or taskbar if the pet window does not open automatically.
candidates.why: Support emails report cases where the pet does not show up on desktop or app will not open ([home_first_view, bug]).

new_pet_visibility_helper.headline: Locating Your Desktop Pet
new_pet_visibility_helper.body: If your pet hides behind other apps, click the pet icon in your taskbar or system tray to bring it back to the front.

guard.reason: Adding a helper screen after home intro is explicitly permitted under onboarding rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Support and funnel point to this issue, but historical tests show finish new_screen changes yield +0.0% lift.

candidates.title: waiting_stage_progress_info
candidates.change: Display time estimates and step counts on the waiting screen during pet generation.
candidates.why: The home stage has a high median time (201s) and mean time (2336s) where users lack progress feedback while waiting.

guard.reason: Updating waiting screen information with step progress and time estimates is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Home step has long wait times (201s median); progress feedback reduces drop-off during generation.

candidates.title: story_full_bleed_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the initial story screen into a full-bleed visual showcase introducing the desktop pet concept.
candidates.why: The choose_path stage suffers from a long mean duration (514s), requiring stronger early engagement.

story.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
story.body: A animated pet living right on your desktop, ready to hang out while you work and browse.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout while continuing to introduce the pet is valid.

candidates.score_note: Full redesigns historically underperform or show negative results, alongside high implementation cost.

candidates.title: upload_photos_quality_checklist
candidates.change: Add a photo requirement checklist to the photo upload screen to ensure high-quality source photos.
candidates.why: Support received reports that custom pets fail to generate or look wrong due to bad input images ([adoption_or_generation, bug]).

components.text: Bright lighting, sharp focus, single pet facing camera

guard.reason: Adding a photo quality checklist component to the upload_photos screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targeting lowest conversion step with strong support mail evidence; checklist prevents user input errors.

candidates.title: sign_in_after_adoption_certificate_reorder
candidates.change: Move sign-in to take place immediately after finalizing the pet adoption certificate.
candidates.why: 8 support emails report missing or reset pets after signing in, which occurs when users sign in before establishing their pet choice.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in after the adoption certificate is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Supported by 8 emails, but previous sign_in reorder test resulted in -7.2% conversion.

candidates.title: sign_in_existing_account_hint
candidates.change: Add explanatory hint text on sign_in emphasizing that returning users should sign in with their existing account to sync saved pets.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets mention pets missing or being reset after signing into a new or incorrect account.

sign_in.hint: Returning user? Sign in with your original account to restore your existing pets.

guard.reason: Adding an explanatory sign-in hint for returning users is valid.

candidates.score_note: Fixes account reset confusion reported in 8 support emails using a simple, low-risk hint.

candidates.title: new_pet_desktop_controls_flow
candidates.change: Insert an interactive tutorial screen after home intro showing basic desktop controls for dragging, right-clicking, and hiding the pet.
candidates.why: Support received multiple messages regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the desktop pet ([after_onboarding, confusion]).

new_pet_controls_demo.headline: How to Interact With Your Pet
new_pet_controls_demo.body: Click and drag to move your pet around your screens, or right-click to open its menu.

guard.reason: Adding an interactive tutorial screen after home intro is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: New flow additions consistently show no clear positive effect across past tests and require full release.

candidates.title: adoption_certificate_compact_layout
candidates.change: Switch the adoption certificate screen to a compact layout to decrease visual clutter during naming.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has the lowest step conversion rate (68.4%), so simplifying certificate finalization helps user momentum.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Give your new companion a name to finalize adoption.

guard.reason: Changing the adoption certificate layout to compact while preserving its core function is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Modest layout simplification on the lowest conversion step, but lacking specific support mail backing.

candidates.title: home_intro_notify_when_ready
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification options on home intro screen when pet initialization completes.
candidates.why: Finish step has a very high mean time (5815s) because users switch away while waiting for pet loading.

home_intro.hint: We'll notify you as soon as your pet lands on your desktop!

guard.reason: Enabling notification options on the home intro screen is allowed under onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Directly targets extreme mean time (5815s) caused by background waiting with ready notifications.
